name: RTK — Rust Token Killer
hook: 56.8k-star single Rust binary that transparently cuts LLM token consumption 60–90% on common dev commands. Installs a PreToolUse hook in Claude Code's settings.json and rewrites Bash calls at the proxy layer — no manual changes to workflow. Confirmed benchmarks from independent testers show 60–90% savings with zero configuration drift. Supports 13 AI coding tools.

name: claude-mem
hook: 79.9k-star persistent-context plugin — hooks into Claude Code's session lifecycle, captures every tool use/file read/edit, compresses observations with Claude's agent-sdk into SQLite, and injects relevant context at the start of the next session. Now at v12.6.4 with 259 releases, 109 contributors, and multi-machine sync via claude-mem-sync over SSH. Works across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Copilot, OpenCode.

name: CodeGraph

name: Claude Plugins Official (Anthropic)
hook: Anthropic's own curated plugin directory — 28.9k stars, 684 open issues reflecting active community submissions. Houses first-party Anthropic plugins alongside vetted external_plugins from partners. The canonical install path used by Microsoft's Azure Skills and other official integrations. Browse and install with '/plugin > Discover' inside Claude Code.

name: Graphify
hook: 56.9k stars. Type /graphify and Claude Code maps the entire project — source code (31 languages), SQL schemas, docs, PDFs, images, even videos — into an interactive knowledge graph. Outputs graph.html (clickable, filterable), GRAPH_REPORT.md, and graph.json for future queries. Uses Tree-sitter static analysis + LLM semantic extraction. CLSkillsHub reports up to 49× token reduction on architectural questions vs. grep-based context.

name: OpenCode (SST)
hook: The open-source Claude Code alternative from SST just overtook Anthropic's own repo: 161k stars vs. Claude Code's 124k. Supports 75+ model providers including fully local Ollama inference at zero cost. After Anthropic's March 2026 legal request, all Claude Pro/Max OAuth references were removed. 850+ contributors, 11k commits, roughly 6.5M monthly active developers.

name: How Anthropic Contains Claude Across Products (Simon Willison)
hook: May 30 post synthesizing Anthropic's agent containment stack for the first time publicly: claude.ai uses gVisor, Claude Code local uses Seatbelt (macOS) and Bubblewrap (Linux), Claude Cowork runs a full VM (Apple Virtualization on macOS, HCS on Windows). Core insight: credentials that never enter the sandbox can't be exfiltrated regardless of the model's behavior.

name: claude-code-best-practice
hook: 55.7k-star 'from vibe coding to agentic engineering' reference guide. Documents 83+ practical tips across prompting, context management, cross-model bridging (Codex, Gemini, DeepSeek, local), and multi-agent orchestration patterns. Synthesizes the architectural pattern 'every major workflow converges on' — Command → Agent → Skill — with copy-paste orchestration templates for .claude/ directories.

name: Azure Skills Plugin (Microsoft Official)
hook: v1.1.62 shipped May 29 — official Microsoft plugin synced from the GitHub Copilot for Azure repo. Packs 20+ Azure skills into Claude Code: azure-prepare, azure-validate, azure-deploy, azure-kubernetes, azure-diagnostics, azure-cost, azure-rbac, and entra-app-registration, among others. Installs from the claude-plugins-official marketplace and works across Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, and VS Code.

name: claude-video (/watch skill)
hook: 1.6k-star plugin that adds /watch to Claude Code: give it any video URL and it downloads, extracts frames at an adaptive rate, transcribes audio, and hands everything to Claude for analysis. v0.1.3 shipped May 8. Tight two-command install via the plugin marketplace.

name: claude-code-skills + Hex MCP Suite
hook: 480-star plugin bundle for full delivery lifecycle: 7 installable plugins (agile-workflow, codebase-audit-suite, documentation-pipeline, project-bootstrap, optimization-suite) plus 4 bundled MCP servers — hex-line (hash-verified file editing with content validation), hex-graph (code knowledge graph), hex-ssh (remote SSH editing), and hex-research (markdown hypothesis indexing). name: cco — Claude Code Sandbox Wrapper
hook: 402-star drop-in safety layer: wraps every Claude Code invocation in the best sandbox available — sandbox-exec (macOS), bubblewrap (Linux), or Docker as fallback. Lets Claude's autonomous mode run without constant permission prompts while keeping risky operations contained. Single curl install; 372 commits of active development.

name: Awesome Claude Code Toolkit
hook: 1.9k-star all-in-one reference: 135 specialized agents organized into 10 domains (core dev, language experts, infrastructure, QA, data & AI, DX, specialized, business, orchestration, research), 35 curated skills, 42 commands, 176+ plugins, 20 hooks, 15 rules, 14 MCP configs, 26 companion apps, and 52 ecosystem entries.
